title: Mobile Measurement, Attribution & Fraud Intelligence Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

This is a remote position.

**ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

Xapads Media is a global advertising technology company helping brands reach audiences and grow their businesses across mobile performance, programmatic advertising and connected TV. Through Xerxes, our Mobile Performance DSP, we support measurable user acquisition across app and OEM ecosystems. We believe in building dependable technology, strong industry partnerships and quality-led solutions that evolve with the market.

**For more information, visit**
https://www.xapads.com

**ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

Mobile measurement is a fast-evolving ecosystem shaped by Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs), OEMs, privacy frameworks and measurement-quality technologies. Attribution policies, integration requirements and industry best practices continue to develop. Our focus is to stay closely connected to these developments and keep Xerxes aligned with current measurement standards, partner requirements and responsible supply practices.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a specialist who understands the MMP ecosystem and enjoys turning industry developments into practical product guidance. You will stay closely connected with leading MMPs, OEMs and measurement-quality partners, understand their latest policies and technical requirements, and work with Xerxes Product and Engineering teams to keep our platform aligned, prepared and compliant. This is a forward-looking role focused on ecosystem knowledge, partner collaboration and continuous product readiness, with fraud prevention as an important part of overall measurement and supply quality.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

·      
**MMP ecosystem alignment:**
Maintain an up-to-date understanding of MMP policies, attribution standards, technical requirements and applicable compliance expectations for Xerxes.

·      
**Measurement and supply standards:**
Help establish clear guidelines for attribution accuracy, integration validation, supply quality and responsible fraud prevention.

·      
**Industry partnerships:**
Build productive working relationships with MMP product and technical teams, OEMs and measurement-quality providers to exchange updates and best practices.

·      
**Product readiness:**
Translate new partner policies and ecosystem developments into practical recommendations for Xerxes Product and Engineering teams.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

·      
**Follow industry developments:**
Stay informed about MMP policy updates, attribution methodologies, API and postback requirements, privacy-related measurement changes and quality standards.

·      
**Assess relevance for Xerxes:**
Understand how new MMP requirements affect our measurement flows, integrations, publisher ecosystem and product capabilities.

·      
**Strengthen measurement quality:**
Work with MMPs and quality partners to understand fraud-prevention standards, validation methods and traffic-quality signals as part of a proactive quality framework.

·      
**Collaborate with OEMs and supply partners:**
Understand their user-acquisition journeys, integration requirements and measurement expectations to support reliable, compliant supply.

·      
**Guide Product and Engineering:**
Turn external policy and technical updates into clear product recommendations, support implementation planning and help validate agreed changes.

·      
**Keep teams informed:**
Share timely, simple guidance and best practices with Product, Supply, Operations and Customer Success so everyone works from current ecosystem requirements.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

·      
**Relevant experience:**
4–5 years in mobile measurement, attribution, technical integrations, ecosystem compliance or closely related product and solutions roles.

·      
**MMP ecosystem expertise:**
Strong understanding of leading MMPs such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular and Branch, including attribution policies, partner requirements and integration standards.

·      
**Measurement and quality knowledge:**
Ability to interpret attribution outcomes, validation requirements and fraud-prevention signals, and apply them to practical DSP and supply-quality guidelines.

·      
**Technical understanding:**
Working knowledge of postbacks, S2S/API flows, SDK concepts, event mapping, attribution windows and integration validation.

·      
**Product advisory capability:**
Experience converting partner policies, measurement updates and technical standards into actionable guidance for Product and Engineering.

·      
**Industry curiosity and collaboration:**
A proactive approach to tracking ecosystem developments and building constructive relationships with MMP, OEM and quality-technology teams.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

·      
**Direct MMP experience:**
Previous work in Product, Solutions, Technical Integration or Measurement teams at a major MMP.

·      
**OEM exposure:**
Experience with Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, Transsion or similar device ecosystems and their acquisition and measurement flows.

·      
**Measurement-quality tools:**
Familiarity with Protect360, mFilterIt, TrafficGuard, FraudScore or similar solutions and their role in industry best practices.

·      
**Proactive product alignment:**
Experience helping a product team adopt new MMP policies or technical standards ahead of their effective dates.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

·      
**Current ecosystem alignment:**
A clear understanding of the latest applicable MMP requirements, with a documented plan to keep Xerxes aligned as policies evolve.

·      
**Defined quality standards:**
Practical measurement, integration-validation and supply-quality guidelines agreed with Product, Engineering and relevant teams.

·      
**Stronger MMP collaboration:**
Active working relationships with key MMP and quality-technology teams, helping Xerxes receive, interpret and act on relevant updates in time.

·      
**Trusted, future-ready Xerxes:**
Measurable progress toward making Xerxes known for dependable measurement, consistent compliance practices and quality-led mobile user acquisition.

**LIFE AT XAPADS MEDIA**

At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

To learn more about our culture and ways of working, visit: https://www.xapads.com/life-at-xapads

**LOCATION**

Remote

**HOW TO APPLY**

To apply for this position, send an email to our careers mailbox (career@xapads.com). In the email make sure to include your resume and any additional information you would feel relevant for this role.
